notes: The encoding is resolved with Encoding::for_label in every call, then encode and decode_without_bom_handling, copying the text into an owned String. The inputs have no unmappable characters.
details: The encoding is resolved from its label with Encoding::for_label in every call; then encode and decode_without_bom_handling; the decoded text is copied into an owned String. Unmappable characters do not occur in the inputs.
